backend.uuid_policy: Record selected GPU 0 UUID for each run; UUIDs are ephemeral and not compared across versions.

claims_not_supported: no formal Grid Convergence Index or asymptotic-order qualification
no absolute or literature Cd validation; the dimensionless sphere domain is a capability fixture
no target-aerodynamics, full-vehicle, high-Re, gradient, reverse-mode, topology, v16 or optimizer claim
claims_supported: analytic and sampled GridSDF sphere primals complete on the registered T4 backend at 16, 24 and 32 cells per diameter
the sampled geometry stays within the registered per-grid analytic comparison bound
the finest-two-grid Cd response is assessed against the preregistered 3% W2b PoC candidate bound
failure_policy: Any failed gate is a diagnostic stop; preserve outputs, do not change thresholds after observing the GPU results, and register a new immutable round before retry.

domain.boundary_conditions: same registered WaterLily Simulation defaults as W2-T4a/W2-T4b; uniform inflow uBC=(U,0,0), no periodic direction, exitBC disabled

geometry.analytic_mode: exact sphere SDF evaluated in solver coordinates
geometry.gridsdf_mode: canonical CPU GridSDF -> CuArray exact round-trip -> GridSDFWaterLilyBody

time.primary_time_mean: trapezoidal physical-time-weighted mean over the registered [40,60] tU/D samples

gates_registered_before_measurement.T0_prerequisites: All registered prior result, criteria, Project/Manifest and source-file hashes match.
gates_registered_before_measurement.T10_finest_grid_response: For each geometry mode, symmetric relative difference between time-weighted Cd at 24 and 32 cells/D <= 3%. This is the registered W2b PoC candidate bound; not a formal GCI. Also report 16-24 and 24-32 changes and whether the latter decreases.
gates_registered_before_measurement.T11_runtime_vram: Every case has positive wall time and ms/step, and 0 < peak_vram_bytes < vram_total_bytes.
gates_registered_before_measurement.T12_backend_identity: Two Tesla T4s are inventoried; selected first UUID is recorded; NVIDIA driver, CUDA driver API version, CUDA runtime version, compute capability, Julia, CUDA.jl, WaterLily, Project and Manifest match this registration.
gates_registered_before_measurement.T13_artifact_retrieval: Exact Kaggle version has a DONE marker and every file in its SHA-256 manifest verifies locally.
gates_registered_before_measurement.T1_completion: All six registered cases complete through at least 60 tU/D with the exact case inventory and parameters.
gates_registered_before_measurement.T2_finiteness: u and p arrays are finite at completion for every case.
gates_registered_before_measurement.T3_force_finite: Every value in every case force CSV is finite, the sample count matches, and CSV SHA-256 matches its summary.
gates_registered_before_measurement.T4_drag_sign: Window-mean drag is positive for all six cases.
gates_registered_before_measurement.T5_stationarity: For each case, |first-half mean drag - second-half mean drag| / |whole-window mean drag| <= 0.02.
gates_registered_before_measurement.T6_lift_bound: For each case, abs(window-mean lift) / window-mean drag <= 0.10.
gates_registered_before_measurement.T7_canonical_grid: Each GridSDF case has the exact canonical phi and device-round-trip SHA; measured margin >= 0.15 m and within 1e-6 m of 0.19999998807907104 m; separately reported configured gate equals 0.15 m.
gates_registered_before_measurement.T8_16_baseline_agreement: At 16 cells/D, analytic and GridSDF window-mean drag each agree within 1% of the existing matching W2-T4a/W2-T4b T4 result.
gates_registered_before_measurement.T9_geometry_interpolation_agreement: At each rung, analytic-vs-GridSDF time-weighted Cd relative difference <= 1%; motivated by the previously observed ~0.22% same-fixture cross-geometry difference with over 4x margin.
